description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of an old slavic village of log houses at the edge of a forest, made of logs, planks, thatch and wooden shingles, no stone houses and no tiled roofs, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the village trial hall where fighters prove themselves: a tall narrow log tower-like hall with a pointed shingle roof and a small lookout on top, a wide carved door glowing with faint pale cyan runes along its frame, iron-bound shields on the walls, a training dummy of straw and a rack of wooden swords beside the entrance, two torches
